cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Information Security Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT or related field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years' experience in Information Technology related areas.
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Preferred Requirements
MS degree.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).

cond_0009.intro: The Information Security Analyst will work with teams across [Company name masked] to improve and maintain a comprehensive Information Security Program. This includes coordinating with all aspects of the client environment — including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams — to help ensure compliance with all mandates from the governing body. Together with colleagues, this role works to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of systems and information assets, and supports ongoing data security and validation against current security standards.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends and share recommendations for company-wide best practices to keep the organization current on protective technologies.
Coordinate and conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and work with the team to address them before an outside attack occurs.
Track and coordinate known cyber vulnerabilities in collaboration with relevant teams, following them through to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Support system monitoring and remediation efforts to help manage security alerts and identify and reduce false positives.
Work with colleagues to develop cybersecurity-related strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies and share findings with the team to support the cyber security area.
Coordinate with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work alongside other IT Security team members to share information and support a secure, proactive IT security environment.
Coordinate with emergency management and COOP Planners to help ensure that the Information Technology recovery plan is fully aligned with COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents together with relevant stakeholders, including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor-supplied security hardware components and software packages in coordination with the team.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and work with colleagues to identify and analyze security risks.
Coordinate security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Collaborate on creating and managing cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Share status and progress on efforts with management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years of experience in Information Technology related areas.
Degree: B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time and multitask in high-demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Preferred Requirements
MS degree preferred.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).

It involves regular contact with all aspects of the client environment, including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams, to ensure compliance with all mandates from the governing body. This role works to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an ongoing basis, this position manages all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0033.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, stay current, and actively share recommendations for company-wide best practices to promote use of the latest technology.
Coordinate and conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and address them before an outside cyber-attack occurs.
Track and coordinate known cyber vulnerabilities, following them through to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify and reduce false positives.
Develop cybersecurity-related strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cybersecurity area.
Coordinate directly with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work closely and regularly with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor-supplied security hardware components and software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordinate security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Regularly report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0033.requirements:
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies and procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Ability to clearly communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high-demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience required. MS preferred.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years of experience in Information Technology related areas.
Field: Computer Science, IT, or related field.

This role seeks to protect against the unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an on-going basis, this position will manage all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0041.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0041.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience with designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience. Field: Computer Science, IT or related field.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years' experience in Information Technology related areas.
Preferred Requirements
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
MS degree preferred.

cond_0049.intro: The Information Security Analyst is responsible for improving and maintaining a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. It would include working with all aspects of the client environment including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams to ensure compliance to all mandates from the governing body. This role seeks to protect against the unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an on-going basis, this position will manage all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of security systems and how vulnerabilities connect across an environment.
cond_0049.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0049.requirements:
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience required. MS preferred.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years' experience in Information Technology related areas.
Field: Computer Science, IT or related field.

Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.

Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.

Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.

Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.

cond_0209.requirements:
Advanced knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Deep expertise in network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.

Demonstrated expertise in setting up firewall rules.
Substantial experience performing computer forensics.
Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Proven experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Strong command of writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Exceptional ability to communicate technical information clearly and effectively to colleagues and management.
Strong ability to manage time and prioritize competing demands in high-pressure scenarios.
Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and deliver solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively sound.
Ability to provide accurate, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).

It would include working with all aspects of the client environment including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams to ensure compliance to all mandates from the governing body. This role seeks to protect against the unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an on-going basis, this position will manage all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0226.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0226.requirements:
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience required. MS preferred.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years' experience in Information Technology related areas.
Field: Computer Science, IT or related field.

The role is responsible for improving and maintaining a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. It involves working with all aspects of the client environment, including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams, to ensure compliance with mandates from the governing body. This role seeks to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. This position manages all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0250.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends to keep current and produce recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Conduct simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and address them before an outside cyber-attack.
Track and coordinate known cyber vulnerabilities through to completion, ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify and reduce false positives.
Develop cybersecurity-related strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to support the cybersecurity function.
Coordinate with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Share information with other IT Security team members to support a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Coordinate with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure the Information Technology recovery plan is aligned with COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor-supplied security hardware components and software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordinate security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0250.requirements:
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies and procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and handle multiple tasks when appropriate in potentially high-demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience required. MS preferred.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years of experience in Information Technology related areas.
Field: Computer Science, IT, or related field.

cond_0258.intro: The Information Security Analyst is responsible for improving and maintaining a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. The role involves working closely with all aspects of the client environment, including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams, to ensure compliance with all mandates from the governing body. You will regularly connect with teams across [Company name masked] to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of systems and information assets, and to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0258.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, keep current, and actively share recommendations for company-wide best practices to promote use of the latest technology.
Coordinate and conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in computer systems, and work with relevant teams to address them before an outside cyber-attack occurs.
Track and coordinate known cyber vulnerabilities, following them through to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify and reduce false positives.
Develop cyber security related strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordinate directly with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work closely and regularly with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components and software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordinate security assessments with internal audit and external vendors, staying in regular contact throughout the process.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years of experience in Information Technology related areas.
B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience with designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask in high demand scenarios.
Preferred Requirements
MS degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies and procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.

cond_0298.intro: The Information Security Analyst is responsible for improving and maintaining a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. It would include working with all aspects of the client environment including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams to ensure compliance to all mandates from the governing body. This role seeks to protect against the unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an on-going basis, this position will manage all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0298.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0298.requirements:
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide competent, realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. Or equivalent experience required. MS preferred.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years' experience in Information Technology related areas.
Field: Computer Science, IT or related field.

cond_0332.intro: The Information Security Analyst is responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. This includes taking ownership of all aspects of the client environment — including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams — to ensure compliance with all mandates from the governing body. This role leads efforts to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an ongoing basis, this position drives all security activities across [Company name masked] to ensure data security and alignment with current security standards.
cond_0332.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, and lead adoption of current technology to protect our information by setting company-wide best practice recommendations.
Plan and execute frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and resolve them before an outside cyber-attack occurs.
Own tracking and resolution of known cyber vulnerabilities through to completion, ensuring all are properly closed out.
Direct system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Develop cyber security strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to advance the cyber security program.
Lead coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Drive information sharing with other IT Security team members to maintain a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Coordinate with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure the Information Technology recovery plan is fully aligned with COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, including assessing damage potential.
Execute computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor-supplied security hardware components and software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Own coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Develop security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Handle confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0332.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, and PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of two (2) years of cybersecurity experience and a total of 5 or more years of experience in Information Technology related areas.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures, and documenting security breaches.
Ability to efficiently and effectively communicate technical information to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time efficiently and multitask in potentially high-demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Master's degree.

Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0408.requirements:
Working knowledge of NIST Cyber Security Framework, CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Experience performing computer forensics.
Background in designing, implementing and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Experience working with outside vendors to coordinate testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures and documenting security breaches.
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time and multitask when appropriate in potentially high demand scenarios.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time requirements for assigned initiatives.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications, or willingness to obtain: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH).
Degree: B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT or related field, or equivalent practical experience. MS preferred.
Around 2 years of cybersecurity experience and a total of around 5 years of experience in Information Technology related areas, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
cond_0408.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0408.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

It would include working with all aspects of the client environment including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams to ensure compliance to all mandates from the governing body. This role seeks to protect against the unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets. On an on-going basis, this position will manage all activities across [Company name masked] to ensure ongoing data security and validation with current security standards.
cond_0417.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends, to keep current and promote use of the latest technology to protect our information by creating recommendations for company-wide best practices.
Coordinate/Conduct frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to look for vulnerabilities in the computer systems and take care of these before an outside cyber-attack.
Tracking and coordinating known cyber vulnerabilities following them to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Assist in system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify/reduce false positives.
Development cyber security related strategies and approaches including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies to assist in the cyber security area.
Coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Work with other IT Security team members to share information and promote a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Work with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure that the Information Technology's recovery plan is fully coordinated with the COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents including assessing damage potential.
Perform computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor supplied security hardware components & software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Assist in developing security awareness and training programs for IT and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Work with confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
cond_0417.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Background in NIST Cyber Security Framework and CIS Security Controls.
Experience with network and application security including firewalls, VLANs, routers, switches, Linux, Microsoft Windows and VMware operating systems, Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases, ecommerce, PCs.
Some experience performing penetration testing.
Experience setting up firewall rules.
Around 2 years of cybersecurity experience and a total of around 5 years in Information Technology related areas, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
B.A./B.S. In Computer Science, IT, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), or Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) — or willingness to obtain.
Ability to communicate technical information clearly to colleagues and management.
Ability to manage time and handle multiple tasks when needed.
Ability to solve problems and provide solutions that are technically, financially, and administratively responsible.
Ability to provide realistic estimates for cost, effort, and time for assigned work.
Preferred Requirements
Experience performing computer forensics.
Experience with designing, implementing, and managing an enterprise-wide security program.
Working knowledge of coordinating with outside vendors on testing and resolution of security vulnerabilities.
Experience writing recovery plans, updating policies/procedures, and documenting security breaches.
MS degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
cond_0417.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

cond_0485.intro: We are looking for an Information Security Analyst to join our team. This role owns the development and maintenance of a comprehensive Information Security Program for [Company name masked]. You will take responsibility for all aspects of the client environment, including the SCADA network and radio maintenance teams, to ensure compliance with all mandates from the governing body. You will lead efforts to protect against unauthorized access, modification, or destruction of [Company name masked]'s systems and information assets, and drive ongoing data security and validation against current security standards.
cond_0485.responsibilities:
Research the latest information technology security trends and deliver recommendations for company-wide best practices to keep [Company name masked] ahead of emerging threats.
Lead frequent simulated cyber-attacks and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and resolve them before an outside cyber-attack occurs.
Own the tracking and resolution of known cyber vulnerabilities, driving each to completion and ensuring all are properly closed out.
Direct system monitoring and remediation to manage security alerts and identify and reduce false positives.
Develop cybersecurity strategies and approaches, including a cybersecurity breach contingency and recovery plan.
Research new tools and technologies and determine their applicability to the cyber security program.
Lead coordination with external entities on critical cyber matters.
Drive information sharing with other IT Security team members to maintain a secure and proactive IT security environment.
Coordinate with emergency management and COOP Planners to ensure the Information Technology recovery plan is fully aligned with COOP and emergency plans.
Investigate and document security breaches and other cybersecurity incidents, including assessing damage potential.
Execute computer forensics as needed.
Implement and maintain vendor-supplied security hardware components and software packages.
Perform diagnostics for security problems and identify and analyze security risks.
Own the coordination of security assessments with internal audit and external vendors.
Develop security awareness and training programs for IT staff and employees who work with sensitive data.
Create and manage Cyber Security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
Handle confidential information obtained through security scans and assessments of client systems.
Report status and progress on efforts to management as necessary.
Other related security duties as assigned.
